availability: Optional extension included in Framework 0.5.0; query the exact version and sizes. Availability does not establish game or Multiplayer compatibility.
owner: Exact active doodesch.multiplayer native owner and retained registered provider
thread: Bound game thread; synchronous nonblocking callbacks; retained storage through Step unbind

functions.bind: Bind the observer to an existing ARMED Step lease before activation
functions.read: Copy a retained local receipt on the exact lease/thread without native work
functions.operation: Perform the named single-use operation only in the separate recovery service

callbacks.observe: Transport-only observed physical IDs and process nonces before normal live membership proof
callbacks.local_proof: Retained NativeOpen/selected-file proof bypassing only live membership liveness
callbacks.service: Separate recovery control; never lends Next or ordinary command/tick admission
callbacks.witness: Fresh full covered Host observation after preparation and around capture
callbacks.publication: Readback of full completed file and companion bytes, hashes and durability

rules: Freeze original physical IDs and unique process nonces for all populated slots 1..4
Same-account restarts cannot acknowledge their predecessor
Freeze every observed original survivor; never shrink the attempt cohort
Do not reduce or reinterpret normal Step snapshot or peer ACK predicates
No FAILED-to-HELD transition, replay, Go/Timer preparation or task queue/RNG writes
Consume preparation and capture before the first native side effect; preserve unknown results
PUMP continues only the exact consumed original writer
Retirement admission is not proof of actual native destruction or a peer acknowledgement
New gameplay requires original Quit/Title retirement and normal new-session bootstrap agreement
